answer: The window stays open long enough for watchers to object, and the challenge is settled on-chain. A Connext xCall settles after a fraud window, so anyone can challenge a bad message before it finalizes. A farm needs 379 separate xCalls, since one fraud window cannot cover 379 messages. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the crystal signal is public, the quartz check is automatic, and 379 aliases cost 379 times what one real agent costs, with the pulse trail open to all.
